haiku.problem: The question asks 'Who did the prophet call blessed?' but the lesson's verse says 'Blessed are all who wait for Him' and the answer 'All who wait for Him' is fine; however the question text states the LORD 'is a just God who longs to be gracious', which repeats the setup from question 1 and adds a fact from verse 18 that is not needed. More importantly, the question-1 text was rewritten to 'A prophet told God's people in Jerusalem', which uses the passage's wording rather than a plain name-free description, so this is acceptable. No clear rule violation here beyond minor redundancy.

Lesson-specific wording 'the silver-plated and gold-plated idols' is taken from verse 22 and is clear; however the question states 'A prophet said God's people would turn from idols' which is not in verse 22 (the verse says they will desecrate and throw away idols, not that they will turn from them). This adds a claim not directly stated, though it is a reasonable reading.

The question says 'the LORD would speak against Assyria', which is not stated in the verses; verse 31 says Assyria will be shattered at the voice of the LORD, but 'speak against Assyria' is a paraphrase that adds meaning. The question also repeats the answer's wording 'shattered' is not repeated, so the main problem is the added claim.
